title: Ariz. Rev. Stat. § 12-542 — Personal injury actions
content:
Ariz. Rev. Stat. § 12-542

A. Except as provided in section 12-551, a person shall bring an action for any of the following within two years after the cause of action accrues:

1. For injuries to the person or for wrongful death.

2. For injury to the reputation of another by libel or slander.

title: Ariz. Rev. Stat. § 47-2725 — Statute of limitations in contracts for sale
content:
Ariz. Rev. Stat. § 47-2725

1. An action for breach of any contract for sale must be commenced within four years after the cause of action has accrued. By the original agreement the parties may reduce the period of limitation to not less than one year but may not extend it.

title: Soldo v. Mackay, 214 Ariz. 429 (2007)
content:
Soldo v. Mackay, 214 Ariz. 429 (2007).

[Excerpt — holding summary.]

The Supreme Court of Arizona held that Arizona follows pure comparative fault and a plaintiff's recovery is reduced by the plaintiff's percentage of fault without barring recovery.

opinionParts.content: Arizona follows pure comparative fault; a plaintiff's recovery is reduced by the plaintiff's percentage of fault without barring recovery.
